description: This file contains extension methods for configuring dependency injection services in an ASP.NET Core application, specifically for setting up services related to the Conduit project, including JWT authentication, logging, validation, and MediatR pipelines.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure services in dependency injection for the Conduit application.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Configures MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, and application-specific services like password hashing, JWT token generation, and current user accessor.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Sets up JWT authentication with token validation parameters and event handling for token extraction from headers.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Configures Serilog logging for the application's ILoggerFactory.
